subject: spaceGalley
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: spaceship galley kitchen.
Style: Alien (1979) Nostromo.

spec.name: Nostromo Galley
spec.description: A cutaway crew galley in the lived-in 1979 Alien Nostromo style: a grimy beige-and-grey industrial kitchen with a back-wall counter, tall fridge and lockers, a bolted-down crew table with benches, and a CRT and toggle-switch wall.
spec.layout: A room cut away at the front: floor deck, back wall (z=-2.0), +X wall (x=2.0, with a round hatch), -X wall (x=-2.0), and no ceiling, only pipe runs and light boxes along y=2.6. +Z is open to the viewer. Interior is x -2..2, z -2..2, deck top at y=0.1. Everything is a blocky, chunky, practical hardware look: boxes, cylinders and slabs, no curves except pipes, hatch and knobs. The Nostromo style shows as dirty beige and grey painted panels, riveted seams, hazard stripes, amber and CRT-green glow, toggle switches, stencilled warning labels (small red, white and blue plates) and bolted-down furniture. Back wall, left to right (-X to +X): counter run x -1.95..0.65 (sink at x=-1.2, hob at x=-0.1, coffee machine at x=0.35, hood over the hob, upper cabinets above), then the tall fridge and locker bank x 0.65..1.95, with a supply crate stack in the back-right corner. Mid-room: a crew table x -1.15..0.95, z 0.1..1.0, with a bench on each long side. -X wall: a bank of CRT monitors and a switch panel. +X wall: a hatch at z≈0.9. Detail zones are split so nothing overlaps: the shell owns the deck, wall slabs, corner pilasters, the top band above y=2.3 on all walls, the whole +X wall face, the ceiling structure and the hatch. Other parts own what stands on or in front of the walls inside their boxes. Wall colours are hullBeige at the top, hullDark below y=0.5 as a kick band, with hazard stripes on floor edges.

parts.builds: The room structure. (1) Floor deck: a slab x -2.1..2.1, z -2.1..2.0, y 0..0.1 in floorDeck, with an inset grating field in floorGrate (a grid of thin slats and cross-bars, 0.01 proud, covering x -1.9..1.9, z -1.2..1.9, leaving the strip under the counter plain). Hazard-stripe border strips (alternating hazardYellow and hazardBlack small slanted blocks) along the front edge z≈1.95 and around the hatch threshold. Bolt heads on the deck in ribGrey. (2) Wall slabs 0.1 thick: back wall x -2.1..2.1, z -2.1..-2.0, y 0.1..2.6; +X wall x 2.0..2.1, z -2.0..2.0; -X wall x -2.1..-2.0, z -2.0..2.0. Their main colour is hullBeige, and a hullDark kick band y 0.1..0.5 is a separate slab 0.01 proud. (3) Corner pilasters, square ribGrey columns 0.12 wide at the back-left and back-right corners and at the front ends of both side walls, full height to y=2.6, with a rivet row of small steelDark discs. (4) Ceiling structure: ribGrey cross-beams (box girders) spanning x at z=-1.5, 0.0 and 1.5 at y 2.5..2.62, and two long beams along z at x=±1.9. Pipe runs along the ceiling: 4 to 6 horizontal cylinders (radius 0.05 to 0.09) along z and x in pipeGrey and pipeRust with flange rings and valve wheels (small red or amber discs), clamps every 0.5 m, and one pipe drop down the back-right corner. Three flat light boxes under the beams at y 2.45..2.5 (hullGrey frames with white and amberLight glowing panels): one at z=-1.2, one at z=0.5 (centered at x=-0.1, leave room for the table lamp, so offset it to x=0.9), one at z=1.6. (5) Top band: on all three walls above y=2.3, add horizontal panel seams and rivets, stencilled plates in white, redWarn and blueLabel (tiny flat boxes), and ventilation grilles (slatted boxes in steelDark) at x=-1.0 and x=1.0 on the back wall, y 2.35..2.55. (6) The whole +X wall face (x≈1.99), from y=0.5 to 2.3: panel seams every 0.8 m (thin vertical ribGrey strips), rivets, a stencilled red 'GALLEY' bar plate at z=-1.2, y=1.9, and the HATCH centered at hatchCenter: a round bulkhead door of radius 0.55 as a lathe or cylinder along X in hullGrey, with a thick steelDark frame ring, a hazard-stripe outer ring made of alternating small blocks, 8 bolt heads, a central wheel handle (cross of 3 rods and a rim) in steel, a small round porthole (crtDark disc with amberLight glow rim), and a hinge block on the z=0.3 side. Do not put anything on the -X wall face between y=0.5 and 2.3, z>-1.25, and do not put anything on the back wall below y=2.3 except the pilasters.
parts.attaches: Provides deckTop, backWallFace, wallLeftFace, wallRightFace and ceilingLine. Every other part stands on deckTop or against these wall faces. The ceiling hanging lamp of 'table' ties to lampMount on a beam at y=2.6, and the shell must leave x -0.4..0.2, z 0.35..0.75 free of pipes.

parts.builds: The back-wall kitchen run, x -1.95..0.65, z -2.0..-1.3, y 0.1..2.3. Lower units: a base box in cabinetGrey x -1.95..0.65, z -1.98..-1.32, y 0.1..0.92, with a hullDark recessed kick plate; a row of 4 to 5 door fronts (cabinetCream slabs 0.02 proud with ribGrey borders) each with a steel bar handle and a pair of rivets, one door with a hazardYellow stripe and a small redWarn label, and one drawer with an amberLight indicator dot. Countertop: a counterTop slab y 0.92..0.97, x -2.0..0.65, z -2.0..-1.28, with a raised steel lip along the front edge and a splashback strip up the wall (steelDark, y 0.97..1.15). Sink at sinkCenter: a recessed steel basin (dark inner box, steel rim), a tall swan-neck tap (cylinder plus a bent rod, with small red and blue knob discs), and a drain grille. Hob at hobCenter: a steel plate with 4 round burners (steelDark discs with rubber ring grates of crossed thin bars), 4 front knobs (rubber cylinders with white marks) on a control strip, and a small pot with lid (steel cylinder, black handle) and a pan on two burners with a foodGreen and foodTan blob inside. Hood over hoodBase: a trapezoid hood in hullGrey (frustumBox, narrowing upward) at y 1.65..2.1, x -0.55..0.35, with a chimney duct up to y=2.3, a steel mesh underside with a glowing amberLight lamp, and a hazardYellow band. Coffee machine at coffeeSpot (x=0.35): a boxy steel unit 0.3 wide, 0.4 high with a glass jug (small white-translucent-looking box or cylinder, use white), a drip spout, a redWarn power button, amberLight status LED and a toggle. Utensil rail along the back wall at y=1.3 between x -0.5..0.55 with hanging ladle, spatula and whisk (thin rods plus small flat heads in steel and rubber). Upper cabinets: boxes in cabinetGrey x -1.95..-0.6, z -2.0..-1.65, y 1.5..2.3 with 3 doors, latches (steel hook blocks), stencil plates in white/blueLabel, rivets. Also a small shelf at x 0.05..0.65, y 1.55, with 3 labelled jars (cylinders in white, foodTan, foodGreen) and a spice rack. A knife strip magnet bar. Dirty details: darker hullDark smudge patches (flat thin boxes) under the hob and around the sink.
parts.attaches: Back sits against backWallFace (z=-2.0). The right end meets the 'lockers' part at counterLockerSeam (x=0.65). The left end meets the -X wall at x=-2.0. Counter top is at y 0.97 (counterTop mount). The front edge is at z=-1.3 (counterFrontEdge).

parts.builds: The back-right storage block. Tall fridge x 0.65..1.35, z -2.0..-1.3, y 0.1..1.95: body in hullGrey, door in cabinetCream 0.03 proud with ribGrey frame, a thick vertical steel handle (rod with two standoff blocks), a hazard-striped lower kick, a digital temperature display (crtDark box with crtGreen digits made of tiny bars, glowing), a redWarn 'COLD' plate, a white sticker and a blueLabel plate, rivets in two columns, a rubber gasket line. Next to it the locker bank x 1.35..1.95, z -2.0..-1.3, y 0.1..2.3: six stacked-cabinet doors in cabinetGrey (two columns of three, bottom ones taller) with steel latches, numbered plates (white tiny boxes with dark dashes), one padlock hasp (steel) and a few dents (slightly rotated flat darker plates). A top storage box above the fridge x 0.65..1.35, y 2.0..2.3 with 2 small doors. Right of the lockers the +X wall is at x=2.0, so the lockers' right face stays at x=1.95 with a hullDark filler strip. Supply crate stack in the back-right corner at crateCorner (x 1.3..1.95, z -1.25..-0.6): three stacked crates (boxes 0.5 x 0.35 x 0.5 in foodTan and hullDark, with ribGrey corner brackets, hazardYellow stripes and stencilled white text bars), a smaller crate on top slightly rotated, and a strap (rubber thin box) round the stack with a steel buckle. A steel barrel (cylinder, radius 0.2, height 0.5, with 3 ribGrey hoop rings and a redWarn lid label) at x≈0.95, z≈-0.85. On the floor: a cat bowl (Jones) of redWarn short cylinder with a foodTan kibble pile and a tiny steel water dish beside it, at x≈0.65, z≈-1.0. A coiled hose (swept torus-like path in rubber) hung on a steel hook at the side of the lockers if the budget allows.
parts.attaches: Left edge at counterLockerSeam (x=0.65). Back against backWallFace. Right side meets the +X wall (x=2.0). Stands on deckTop. The crate stack must stay within z<-0.6 so the hatch zone (z>0.2 on the +X wall) stays clear.

parts.builds: The crew dining area, centred on tableTop (-0.1, 0.8, 0.55). Table: a steel top slab x -1.15..0.95, z 0.1..1.0, y 0.76..0.82 in steel, with a raised steelDark rim lip, two recessed tray wells, a central hullDark seam strip, hazardYellow corner caps and rivets, on two chunky trestle pedestals (ribGrey boxes with flared feet bolted to the deck by 4 bolt heads each, cross brace bar), x=-0.8 and x=0.6. A bolted-down look. Benches: tops in cabinetGrey with rubber pad strips, y 0.4..0.46, at benchBack (z -0.45..-0.1) and benchFront (z 1.1..1.45), x -1.1..0.9, each on 3 ribGrey leg slabs bolted down, with a hazardYellow edge stripe and a few dirt smudges. Table contents: 3 meal trays (white and hullGrey flat boxes with compartments: foodTan, foodGreen and redWarn bits as tiny boxes and cylinders), 3 mugs (white cylinders with handles made from thin rods; one with a dark rubber coffee disc), a salt and pepper pair, a steel water jug, utensils (thin steel rods in rubber holders), a folded cloth, a stack of 3 plates, a crumpled food packet, and a tiny amber warning lamp. One bench seat holds a jacket (hullDark folded boxes). Hanging lamp at lampMount (x=-0.1, z=0.55): two thin steel rods from the ceiling beam at y=2.6 down to a long lamp box in hullGrey (x -0.7..0.5, y 2.0..2.15) with a white translucent-looking underside panel and amberLight end caps, a cable (rubber rod) draped to the beam. A fold-up condiment shelf is not needed. A pinned paper menu or note with tiny dark lines on the table end is optional. Keep the area x -1.25..-0.3, z 1.0..1.5 clear of tall things so the monitors on the -X wall stay visible.
parts.attaches: Pedestals and bench legs stand on deckTop. The hanging lamp hangs from the beam at ceilingLine (y=2.6) at lampMount. It does not touch any wall. The back bench stays at z>-0.5 so the aisle to the counter (z -1.3..-0.5) stays free.

parts.builds: The -X wall technology bank, x -2.0..-1.7, z -1.25..1.9, y 0.5..2.3, centred on monitorBank (-1.95, 1.4, 0.4); everything faces +X. A wall back-panel in hullGrey 0.05 thick as a base, with ribGrey frame strips. Monitors: three boxy CRT screens in a staggered stack, each an off-white or hullBeige housing box 0.28 deep (extending from the wall to x≈-1.72) with a recessed crtDark face, a glowing crtGreen text pattern (rows of tiny bars of varying length, a tiny cursor block, a small waveform line made of short segments), a bezel, tiny knobs and a vent slot on the side. Sizes: one large (0.7 x 0.55) at y 1.5..2.05, z 0.0..0.7, two smaller (0.45 x 0.35) below it at y 0.95..1.3, z 0.0..0.45 and z 0.5..0.95. Another medium CRT at z 1.1..1.6, y 1.3..1.7 displaying an amberLight status table. Switch panel: a hullDark panel under or beside the screens (z -0.8..-0.1, y 1.0..1.6) with 3 rows of toggle switches (small steel cylinders with rubber tips, alternating up and down), 2 rows of round indicator lights in amberLight, crtGreen and redWarn, two rotary dials (steel cylinders with white pointer marks) and a hazardYellow bordered emergency button (redWarn cap in a steel guard). Menu board near the counter (z -1.2..-0.85, y 1.4..2.0): a slim white board with rows of dark text-bars, a blueLabel header, and a magnet clip. Wall-mounted items: a fire extinguisher (redWarn cylinder with steel nozzle, black hose, white label, bracket) at z=1.75, y 0.7..1.3; a round wall clock (white disc, rim steelDark, tiny hands) at z=-0.55, y=2.1; an intercom unit (hullGrey box with speaker grille slats and an amberLight button) at z=1.3, y=1.9; stencilled signs: a redWarn 'NO SMOKING' plate and a blueLabel 'MOTHER' plate; a cable bundle (rubber swept tubes with clamps) running from the monitors up to the ceiling at y=2.6 and a conduit (pipeGrey cylinder) vertically at z=1.85. A wall-mounted tray rack with 4 slots near the front end, z 1.55..1.9, y 0.7..1.0. Glowing items (screens, LEDs) use the glow kit. Keep it flat against the wall: nothing extends past x=-1.65, and the large pieces stay clear of the -X wall corner pilaster at z>1.88.
parts.attaches: Back faces sit against wallRightFace (x=-2.0). Top edge ends at y=2.3, under the shell's top band. The front edge (z=-1.25) meets the counter's left end beyond x=-2.0 side, so the menu board sits just beside the upper cabinets. Cables run up to the shell's ceilingLine at y=2.6 at z=0.9.

calls.reasoning:
I'm designing a spec for a spaceship galley kitchen in an Alien Nostromo look, with grimy beige panels, CRT screens, pipes, amber lights, steel tables, and a crew table with bench seats. I'm also setting it up as a static model with no joints, and I'm starting to size it at about 4.2 wide.

I'm sketching out the room's geometry now: a 4.2 by 2.6 by 4.0 box with a thin deck, a back wall, and a partial ceiling of pipe runs. The counter will run along the back wall, with the hatch moved to the left side wall.

I'm placing the counter along the back wall, with the fridge and lockers at the far end, and I'm moving the hatch to the left wall. The right wall will carry the CRT monitor and pipes, and I'm leaving the front open and the ceiling mostly bare except for pipe runs along the top edge. Next I'm setting the central table with bench seats in the middle of the room.

Now I'm laying out the crew table: a steel top with a raised rim, bench seats, trays, cups, and cutlery, with a cat food bowl on the floor.

I'm settling the wall layout: the hatch stays on the +X wall as part of the shell, and the monitor bank goes on the -X wall. I'm weighing whether the shell alone has enough to carry, so I'm splitting the rest into a counter, a fridge and locker unit with hanging pots and floor props, the central table, and the wall tech, and I'm keeping the parts from overlapping.

I'm setting the room's interior bounds and wall thicknesses, with the floor deck slab at the bottom and the ceiling at 2.6, pipes running up to 2.7. The floor sits at y=0.1, and I'm fixing the back wall face at z=-2.0 and the two side faces at x=±2.0.

I'm working out the counter's placement along the back wall, with the sink, the hob, and the coffee machine spaced out, and the hood and upper cabinets sitting above them.

I'm fixing the back-right storage run: the fridge and lockers go at x 0.7 to 1.95 along the back wall, with the utensil rail and upper cabinets sized around the hood.

I'm placing the fridge and tall lockers at the back-right corner, and I'm planning the lockers as a bank of numbered doors. The overhead pot rack moves to the table area as a hanging lamp, so it doesn't clash with the table box, and I'm starting to stack supply crates on the floor.

I'm sizing the lockers and fridge against the counter, setting the locker box from z -2.0 to -0.5 and capping it at 2.2 under the 2.6 ceiling. I'm also placing the supply crates and a barrel in the back-right corner, and the cat bowl on the floor, with the hatch set on the +X wall.

I'm placing the crew table so it runs about 2.0 long and 0.9 deep, with a bench on each side. The back bench sits between the table and the walkway by the counter, and the front bench is a little further out.

I'm placing the wall-tech panel on the -X wall, running from z -1.25 to 1.9 and up to y 2.3, with the table's x-extent kept clear of it.

I'm settling the shell as one outline: the floor deck, three walls, ceiling beams, pipe runs, light panels, the hatch, and the trim, all inside a box from -2.1 to 2.1 in x and out to 2.0 in z. I'll keep the shell's wall detail in the zones the counter and lockers don't use, so the flat wall faces don't fight with the decorations.

I'm deciding which walls the shell should decorate. Back wall gets vertical pilaster ribs at the corners and the seam line, with its detail kept above y 2.3. The +X wall stays fully shell-owned apart from the hatch, and the -X wall gets only ribs and a top band, leaving the face between y 0.5 and 2.3 to the wall tech.

I'm listing the palette next, with dirty beige-grey wall panels, grey-blue and steel tones, amber, CRT green, and orange hazard accents, and I'm starting to assign hex values to each named color, staying under 24 entries.

I'm listing the palette entries, the last few hex values for the wall, crt, and warning colors, and I'm counting the names to make sure I stay under 24 entries.

I'm settling on a 24-color palette, and I'm checking that the parts fit a budget of about 900 across five pieces, which keeps me under the 1000-part limit. I'm also writing out the layout details and mounts, with no joints, and the floor-bound parts sitting on the deck while the rest sit above it.

I'm settling the floor-bound parts: the shell is the only one that sits on the floor, and the rest start at 0.1 and sink slightly into the deck. Then I'm pinning the mount points for the deck top, the back and side walls, the ceiling line, and the counter's top and front.

Now I'm listing the mount points for the counter, the table, and the monitor bank.

I'm setting the fridge and lockers to a shared front line at z -1.3, so they match the counter's front edge, and the crates go on the floor just in front of them.

I'm writing out the JSON now, keeping the descriptions detailed but tight.
